title: The Evel Knievel Experience in Las Vegas
includes: Admission to the Evel Knievel Experience
Hotel pick-up and drop off (not included)
Jump VR Experience (available to purchase on site) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the incredible story of America's greatest daredevil at the Evel Knievel Experience, located in Las Vegas' vibrant Arts District. Legendary motorcycles, iconic artifacts and interactive exhibits bring his record-breaking career to life. Stand alongside the famous Skycycle, Big Red truck and the helmet from Evel's legendary Caesars Palace jump as you explore the risks, determination and innovation behind his most daring stunts. Want even more adrenaline? Upgrade your visit on the day to include the immersive VR motorcycle jump and experience what it felt like to ride in Evel's boots.
